title: refactor(mail): replace inline credential building with stoa_auth::build_credential_store
description: mail/main.rs still uses the old inline pattern: CredentialStore::from_credentials + manual secretx block with nested match chains and if let Some(ref path). Should be replaced with stoa_auth::build_credential_store (the same standardisation applied to smtp, reader, and imap in the aubi/gzag work).
